required_madr4_headings: ## Pros and Cons of the Options
zero_self_invention_gate_questions: Q1 Upstream Existence: Does a maintained upstream engine, native AGY primitive, AAIF/CNCF standard, or PyPI/npm/binary package already solve >=80% of the problem?
Q2 LOC & Complexity Ratchet: Is custom code strictly thin, declarative, and free of duplicated runtime engines (config manifests or <=150 LOC single-purpose fail-closed adapters only)?
Q3 Pin & Provenance: Are all dependencies pinned to exact live-verified versions/specs with zero floating tags, zero Nov-30 retiring models, and zero deprecated MCP SEP-2577 surfaces?
Q4 Clean Install Without Fork: Can a clean machine provision the upstream reproducibly via uv, npm ci, mise, or verified official binary without vendoring or mutating upstream source?

Q5 Delete-to-Add & Fitness Proof: Does the addition obey strict anti-bloat budgets (<=24000B rule file, <=20000 aggregate rule tokens, <=3 eager MCP tools, delete-to-add) and ship an executable Confirmation fitness command?
